sourceCameraArt.source: Actual Chromium original WebGL2 & true CHASE, frame times 65.25/66.35/68.05 seconds, three R8B naming convention CLEAN RAW files, original 240Hz camera ticks. Only the previously approved research-only noncolliding K4CS decorative gate was hidden; real B51 warnings and meshes persist.
sourceCameraArt.comparison: R8J prior exact source+source atmospheric R8I; source R8E remains conservative historical visual baseline
sourceCameraArt.verifiedNegative: Most added water channel is buried behind the actual rock/retaining mesh and does not make the wheel's hydraulic purpose readable. At 68.05 seconds, a massive pale channel support intrudes into the turbine silhouette and increases structural clutter. Real source comparison is sufficient to reject the art claim.
sourceCameraArt.verifiedPositive: The source-game comparison proves real editable Blender geometry was drawn, with no false road surface, no collision additions, and authentic original UI/source runner preserved.
sourceCameraArt.reason: The machine was intended to become architecturally connected, but its real-game appearance is not coherent. A correct physical stand-off and a genuine source render do not establish artistic progress.

materialPipelineRootCause.structuralProof: Each triangle is serialized as 3*6=(x,y,z,r,g,b) scalars; a standalone materials-name list exists but per-face material indices, vertex normals, UV coordinates and true Blender BSDF node data are NOT exported into the original WebGL2 mesh.
materialPipelineRootCause.nativeRendererIntegration: scripts/p101-k4ct-install-authored-dcc.mjs currently injects the resulting position/RGB array through the existing original game's 6-float-per-vertex buffer / mesh draw format. R8I adds real sky gradient, not PBR materials.
materialPipelineRootCause.implication: Commercial art cannot be established by making more Blender Principled BSDF materials or 30k+ flat-shaded triangles if the actual original game receives only position+RGB; shader-material data path must be researched in a source-safe separated research copy.
materialPipelineRootCause.notYetImplemented: R9 normal/UV/material-index exporter and isolated source-native shader HAVE NOT been built or certified.
